question.text: PMs offering services to Accredited Investors can have:

answer.text: Lower minimum ticket sizes / customised strategies

explanation.text: The Logic: For accredited investors, the Rs. 50 lakh minimum investment requirement may not apply (subject to disclosures and agreed terms), and large value accredited investors may have up to 100% AUM exposure to unlisted securities subject to disclosures and agreed terms. The Trap: The accredited investor regime relaxes — it does not tighten — investment minimums and strategy customisation. Note: The expanded flexibility for accredited investors is set out in the SEBI portfolio manager framework discussed in the XXI-B workbook.
